adm_notes: Regime own_admission: Israeli universities admit first-degree applicants through their own registration and admission committees on a university-computed composite score (sechem: matriculation average + psychometric test); no national allocation system was found. Applicants/admitted/places: no institution-level 2023/24 counts found. The CBS (cbs.gov.il) publishes candidate tables by university (e.g. the statistical series on higher education, ascala189, covering to 2020/21), but cbs.gov.il refused connections from this environment (connection timed out; not bypassed) and the Wayback CDX lists no captured 2023/24 candidate table or media release (captured CBS media-release pages 2024-2026 were listed: none on candidates for 2023/24). CHE statistical tables (che.org.il/en/statistical-data, tables 1-23) report candidates only by field and institution type, not by university; the CHE 2023/24 opening data digest (Dec 2023) gives national totals only. Haifa-specific selectivity sources not searched beyond the general searches (budget). Mechanism common to the five ISR universities: 'ראויים לקידום' (deserving of advancement) affirmative-action admission. The Society for Advancement of Education (Jerusalem), an NGO, scores applicants 0-60 on a composite of residence area, high school attended, parents' education, family size and special personal/family problems during high school; 30+ points makes the applicant eligible; each university decides autonomously how the score affects admission (Society page, current). Basis coded income_or_socioeconomic;region_or_rural (composite socioeconomic index including area of residence and school; parental education is one component, but the rule is not a first-generation rule, so first_generation is not coded). Mandate institutional: no national law or CHE regulation requiring the track was found in the sources opened (not searched exhaustively; a checker may search CHE decisions). No reserved-place counts, filled counts or shares of entrants admitted under the track were found for 2023/24 (not_published). Haifa 2023/24 (Wayback captures 2023-01-06 and 2023-09-24 of the haifa.ac.il page 'מועמדים ראויים לקידום', identical text): first-degree candidates may apply through the 'ראויים לקידום' track ('אפיק'), assessed by the Society on school, family background, parents' education, family size and area of residence. HOWEVER the page states that the points are 'an indication' and are NOT added to the sechem, and that Haifa does not commit to admit any such candidate; no lowered threshold, bonus or reserved places is stated. Coded yes/separate_track with LOW confidence because the page establishes a named entry track for a disadvantage-defined group; a checker applying the rule strictly could recode to 'no' (benefit unspecified, close to holistic consideration). No programme exclusions stated -> all_programmes. Haifa admission pages are blocked to curl ('Request Rejected'); not bypassed; Wayback captures used. | [coded out] equity_basis=income_or_socioeconomic;region_or_rural | [coded out] equity_mandate=institutional

Regime mixed: first-degree UTME admission to federal universities runs through JAMB (national UTME exam, national minimum UTME score, admissions proposed by the institution on JAMB's Central Admissions Processing System (CAPS), recommended by the head of institution and approved by JAMB), while the university runs its own post-UTME screening, sets programme cut-offs and makes the admission decisions within its approved quota (JAMB 2024 Policy Meeting deck, slide 'CAPS PROCESS - Reminder', read but not entered as a source row: 'No admission can be initiated from JAMB, .........it must come from the institutions'). Equity YES (national rule): the federal admission guidelines allot first-degree admission places in federal institutions Merit 45%, Catchment 35% and Educationally Less Developed States (ELDS) 20%. Only the ELDS 20% is coded as equity (basis region_or_rural: states designated as educationally disadvantaged); the 35% catchment quota (states near the university) is a locality preference not defined by disadvantage and is NOT counted; merit 45% is not equity. equity_reserved_share_pct = 20 (stated share; the base is the institution's admission quota, which was not found published). Instrument: reserved_places (quota) and lower_cutoff (ELDS candidates are ranked within their own category, so their admitting score can be below the merit cut-off; directly documented only for OAU). Mandate: government_regulation (Federal Government admission guidelines applied through the annual JAMB Policy Meeting chaired by the Minister of Education; not a statute). Applicants: not found / not published at institution level for 2023/24 in the sources opened. Studielink application counts per institution are not in DUO open data; the Universiteiten van Nederland page 'Aanmeldingen bacheloropleidingen' returned HTTP 403 to curl and WebFetch (not bypassed). Admitted: no institution-wide count (offers exist only for numerus fixus programmes). Places: empty because most bachelor's programmes have no capacity cap (admission by right with a VWO diploma, WHW 7.24); capacities exist only for numerus fixus programmes (see below). sel_unit refers to the entrant count (persons); no applicant count was entered. Regime 'mixed': open admission with a VWO diploma for most programmes, own selection by the institution (decentral selection, WHW 7.53) for numerus fixus programmes; Studielink is an application portal, not an allocator. Cross-check: RUG Jaarverslag 2023, Bijlage B: 'Instroom eerstejaars-instelling RUG' Bachelor 2023-2024 = 6524 (1cHO; main enrolments entirely new to the RUG, all modes). Numerus fixus 2023/24 (Regeling Inschrijving en Collegegeld 2023-2024 art. 3): Geneeskunde 410, Tandheelkunde 48, Internationale Betrekkingen en Internationale Organisatie 300, Psychologie 600, Kunstmatige Intelligentie 175, International Business 550, Informatica 200, Biologie 300, Biomedische Technologie 125, Farmacie 225 (sum 2,933); plus art. 6.7 selection for University College Groningen LAS and Campus Fryslan GRL. Entrants include Campus Fryslan (Leeuwarden). Equity: no. WHW 7.53 (version 1 Sep 2023) allows selection for capped programmes only on at least two qualitative criteria and/or (unweighted or criteria-weighted) lottery; the RUG summary of the law states that from 2013 until 1 Sep 2023 only selection on at least two qualitative criteria was possible and that criteria must be the same for all candidates at every stage. No national rule reserving places, adding points, lowering thresholds or opening a separate track for disadvantaged groups was found. WHW 7.53(3) requires institutions to 'take into account the interests' of applicants from the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom (in practice: same procedure, remote testing) - a consideration, not a reservation or lower threshold; not coded. The 'Wet herinvoering loting bij numerus fixus' (in force 1 Sep 2023, motivated by kansengelijkheid) adds lottery options, not group-targeted preference. The 21+ entrance exam (colloquium doctum, WHW 7.29) is age-based, not disadvantage-defined. RUG 2023-24 'Reglement Selectie en Plaatsing' (annex to the RIC) contains only the statutory Caribbean consideration; no disadvantage rule. The RUG 2023 framework (14 Nov 2023) sets unweighted lottery as default for capped programmes from later rounds to promote kansengelijkheid - lottery, not a group preference.

Scope: Samordna opptak (national coordinated admission, Opptakstype N), autumn 2023 (Semester 3, i.e. 2023/24 entry), first-degree programme levels Nivåkode B3 (3-year bachelor), M5 (5-year integrated master) and PR (professional programmes such as medicine, psychology, law at some institutions); all programmes and campuses of the institution summed by the collector; all applicants (domestic and foreign; DBH does not split by nationality here). Excluded: one-year programmes (AR, årsstudium, non-degree), local admissions (Opptakstype L) and spring intakes. Applicants = applicants whose first priority (Prioritet 1) was a programme at the institution (qualified and unqualified; 4482 of them qualified, Kvalifisert=1); each Samordna applicant has exactly one first priority, so this is a count of unique persons (unit unique_applicants, first-choice basis). Total application alternatives at all priorities for the same scope = 29993 (unit applications; an applicant can list up to 10 programmes). Admitted = sum of 'Tilbud om opptak' over all priorities (offers recorded per application alternative; in the main round a person holds at most one offer, but offers from the waiting-list/supplementary rounds may count a person more than once - not verified); accepted offers ('Akseptert tilbud') = 2653. Entrants = sum of 'Møtt til studiestart' (enrolled at study start). Places = sum of 'Antall studieplasser' in table 370 for the same programmes: B3 1883 + M5 295 = 2178 (no PR programmes in Samordna at UiS). Admitted and entrants are not restricted to first-choice applicants, so admitted/applicants mixes bases. DBH anonymises cells below 3 for public users (shown as 0), so sums can slightly undercount. Regime central_allocation: Samordna opptak ranks applicants by points within quotas under the national admission regulation (Forskrift om opptak til høgare utdanning, FOR-2017-01-06-13) and allocates one offer per applicant; institutions set places. Local admissions (L) excluded: autumn 2023 B3 373 applications/97 entrants, B4 218/31. EQUITY: no. Searched: Samordna opptak list of admission quotas (Wayback captures 8 Nov 2022 and 6 Aug 2024, bracketing 2023 entry), the Samordna list of quotas for Sámi language competence (Wayback 29 Sep 2022 and 6 Dec 2024), Samordna 'Endringer i regelverk 2023', and the national admission regulation FOR-2017-01-06-13 (current consolidated text on Lovdata; the 2023 text was not opened; § 7-3 was amended by FOR-2023-12-19-2223, after 2023 entry). Not counted as equity: the national 'kvote for førstegongsvitnemål' (50% of places for applicants up to 21 with a diploma on normal time; a merit/age route), gender points (kjønnspoeng; gender is not a listed disadvantage basis), and § 7-13 'særskild vurdering' (individual assessment where another mother tongue, illness, disability or other circumstances distort grade points; the applicant must still show equivalent qualifications - an individual holistic assessment, no reserved places or lower threshold); checker may wish to review § 7-13. adm_notes: Selectivity: Portuguese public universities fill first-degree (licenciatura and integrated master's) places through the Concurso Nacional de Acesso (CNA) run by DGES, which ranks candidates by score across up to six ordered institution/programme preferences: central_allocation. All figures are for the 2023 CNA, 1st phase, summed in code over the 60 institution/programme pairs of Universidade do Minho (2 DGES establishment codes; all schools and campuses) in the DGES StatsEstab23.pdf per-programme table (parsed with pdftotext -raw; new 2023 programmes with no 2022 row handled separately) and cross-checked against the DGES 1st-phase xlsx (places identical programme by programme). places = CNA 1st-phase initial places (2967); they include the priority-contingent places carved out of each programme's places and exclude places of special contests (over-23, international students, holders of other degrees, transfers) and of the 2nd/3rd phases. applicants = 19977 applications ('Candidatos Total' = candidates who listed the programme in any preference, summed over programmes, so a person who listed two programmes of the institution counts twice); unique applicants are not published at institution level. Candidates with one of the institution's programmes as FIRST option = 3954 (persons, first preference only; not entered). admitted = 2882 1st-phase placements (colocados, all contingents; = xlsx Colocados 2875 + ties (desemp.) 1 + placed without final secondary grade 6); 2nd- and 3rd-phase placements not added (they partly re-place candidates already placed). entrants = 2912 = InfoCursos June-2024 database (DGEEC), sheet 'Percentil Entrada', column NumeroMatriculadosCNA2023, summed over the institution's programmes: students who enrolled through the 2023 CNA (the technical note describes them only as 'alunos que entraram pelo CNA'; presumably all three phases). It excludes special-contest and special-regime entrants, so it is not total first-year intake. Rates not computed here. DGEEC 'Vagas e inscritos pela 1.ª vez no Ensino Superior 2023/2024' (Info DGEEC N.º 9) has an institution/programme table of first-time first-year enrolments by entry route, but its file link could not be located (flipbook page); not used. Equity: Portaria n.º 104/2023 (Regulamento do Concurso Nacional de Acesso for 2023-2024, ministerial regulation under DL 296-A/98 art. 28) art. 10(3) creates priority contingents in the CNA 1st phase: (e) candidates with disability, the larger of 4% of 1st-phase places or two places (and 2% or one place in the 2nd phase); (f) beneficiaries of school social action (ação social escolar, ASE: escalão A in the last year of secondary school, or Azores escalões I/II; income-tested), 2% of 1st-phase places or two places (described by DGES as new in 2023). Candidates not placed in a contingent compete in the general contingent (art. 10(6)). Excluded from the equity coding and flagged for the checker: the contingents for candidates from the Autonomous Regions of the Azores (3.5%) and Madeira (3.5%) (defined by regional origin/residence; the regulation does not state disadvantage), emigrants and luso-descendants (7%), and military (2.5%). Per DGES's 2023 ASE page all programmes of all public institutions in the 2023 CNA have the ASE contingent except IPVC, ULisboa and NOVA, so both contingents apply to all of this institution's CNA programmes. equity_reserved_share_pct = 6 = 4 (disability) + 2 (ASE), as stated per programme for the 1st phase; the two-place minimum per contingent and rounding (art. 10(4)) make the effective share higher in small programmes. Reserved place counts were not found as a published institution total and were not computed. Filled: DGES StCEs23.pdf (1st phase, one page per programme, table 'ETAPA COLOCAÇÃO (contingente)', column Cols.) summed in code over the institution's programme pages: Deficientes 12 + ASE 71 = 83 placements; base = all 1st-phase placements 2882 (stage sums reconcile exactly: Geral 2674, Açores 26, Madeira 36, Emigrantes 22, Militares 1, UMinho nursing school regional preference 40). These are placements, not enrolments; 2nd-phase disability placements not added. Scope: the UMinho Escola Superior de Enfermagem (DGES code 7010, one nursing programme) is included; its 40 placements under the 'Pref. Regional' stage are a polytechnic-type regional (area of influence) preference under Portaria 104/2023 art. 19: local origin, not disadvantage-defined, so excluded from equity. No institution-specific admission regulation beyond the national CNA rules was opened; access to these programmes is governed by the CNA regulation.

adm_notes: Selectivity: places and entrants from MOE institutional-research table 學12-2 for 112學年度 (2023/24), day bachelor row (quoted with columns B, D and E). Overseas/foreign new entrants (column D) are reported separately and not added. Applicants and admitted: not published institution-wide in the sources opened; sel_unit left empty because no applicant count is recorded. Taiwan first-degree entry runs through several channels: 繁星推薦 (school-recommendation route allocated centrally by CAC), 申請入學/個人申請 (two stages: CAC first-stage screening on GSAT scores, then the university's own second-stage review and decision, followed by CAC unified allocation; candidates may apply to several programmes), 分發入學 (central score-based allocation by UAC) and 特殊選才 (own admission). No source opened gives unique applicants across channels; per-programme application counts exist for the 個人申請 channel only (e.g. NTU's 112 申請入學錄取情況 PDF; applications, not unique persons; no total row) and were not summed. Regime coded mixed (central allocation for 繁星/分發 plus institution-decided second stage in 個人申請 and own 特殊選才); the regime description rests on the channel documents opened plus general knowledge of the system - FLAG for the checker (no single official regime statement was quoted). Equity: YES. Institutional: NTNU 晨光計畫 'dual-channel' measures in the 申請入學 route (June-2023 Wayback capture of NTNU's 晨光計畫 page): 晨光 1.0 = each department gives priority admission to 1-2 economically disadvantaged candidates (reserved_places within quota; no total stated); 晨光 2.0 = five 晨光招生 programme groups with lowered GSAT screening thresholds and guaranteed places for economically disadvantaged (middle-low-income, special-circumstance families) or culturally disadvantaged (second-generation new immigrants, coded other) students -> separate_track;lower_cutoff. 112 places of the five groups: 學習科學3, 生命科學3, 光電工程2, 企業管理2, 表演藝術2 = 12 (CAC 112 screening-standard table; total computed by the collector). equity_reserved_places = 12 (晨光 2.0 only); base = NTNU day-bachelor within-quota approved places 1,708 (MOE 學12-2; within-quota assumption FLAG). The 2023 page names middle-low-income and special-circumstance families for 2.0 (the current 2026 page also names low-income households). NTNU's own 112 校系分則 for the 晨光 groups was not opened (the archived CAC 112 file for code 002 is only the GSAT-subject list). Filled entrants not published in sources opened. National rule (applies to all five): 原住民學生升學保障及原住民公費留學辦法 (MOE regulation issued under 原住民族教育法 art. 23; current version amended 2019-12-18, in force for 2023/24) gives indigenous applicants supernumerary places (外加名額) of 2% of the approved places (rounded up; may be exceeded for ties and by special decision) and, in the exam-allocation route (分發入學), a bonus of 10% of the raw total score (35% with an indigenous culture and language certificate); in other routes universities may give consideration. Coded reserved_places (supernumerary) + bonus_points; basis race_ethnicity; mandate national_law;government_regulation. equity_reserved_share_pct = 2 is the stated indigenous supernumerary share only (added on top of the approved places, not inside them); the institutional disadvantaged tracks have no stated share, so the 2 is NOT a sum over categories. Disability: a national separate examination track exists (身心障礙學生升學大專校院甄試; 112 university-group registration statistics published on cis.ncu.edu.tw), but institution-level participation and places for 112 were not found in sources opened; disability is coded only where the institution's own track names it. equity_scope all_programmes because the indigenous national rule covers every programme; the institutional tracks cover named groups of programmes in the 申請入學 channel.

adm_notes: REGIME central_allocation: under the MON Admission Procedure 2023 (order No 276) applicants apply electronically through EDEBO (up to 5 applications for state-funded places and 20 in total); state-funded (budget) places on open competitive offers are allocated by 'адресне розміщення бюджетних місць' computed in EDEBO from the NMT-based competitive score and applicants' priorities within national 'широкі конкурси'; the institution sets contract (fee-paying) intake within its licence and ranks contract applicants by the same nationally defined competitive score (arguably mixed for the contract track). For reference only (not entered): abit-poisk.org.ua 2023 offer lists for LNU sum (computed here) to 3106 budget places (BM) and 31007 applications for full-time ПЗСО bachelor offers and 85 BM / 1301 applications for extramural ones; abit-poisk application counts are about 1.8x the vstup.osvita counts for KNU and Lviv Polytechnic, so their definition differs. entrants 5115 from EDEBO official open data (generated 01.01.2026). Admitted not published. EQUITY yes (national rule, applied in the institution's 2023 rules): two reserved shares of STATE-FUNDED places for first-degree entry on the basis of complete secondary school (ПЗСО) or НРК5. Quota-1 (квота-1): set by the institution 'within ten percent (but not less than one place)' of the maximum/total state-order volume of open and fixed competitive offers; eligible: orphans and children deprived of parental care (basis other), persons with disabilities/medical conditions preventing NMT participation (basis disability), persons deprived of liberty due to the armed aggression (other), and also combat participants/Revolution of Dignity victims (service-related, not an equity group under this protocol, but sharing the same quota). Quota-2 (квота-2): residents of temporarily occupied territories, front-line/active-combat settlements or areas de-occupied after 24.02.2022, and those who moved from them (basis region_or_rural: war-affected region of residence). Quota applicants compete among themselves for the quota places ahead of the general list; if not recommended they compete on general conditions. Instrument reserved_places. equity_reserved_share_pct is the SUM of the stated shares: quota-1 is a ceiling ('в межах'), so the actual quota-1 share is <= the stated value and may include non-equity (veteran) applicants; quotas are shares of state-funded places only, not of all (incl. contract) places. Counts of quota places and of entrants admitted under the quotas are published only per competitive offer (rating lists flag quota applicants, e.g. 'КВ2'); no institution-level total was found, so equity_reserved_places and equity_filled_entrants are empty (not published at institution level). Not coded as equity: transfer to vacant state-funded places (розділ VIII пп.10-11) for IDPs, children from families with 5+ children, disabled persons etc. already enrolled on contract (a funding-transfer priority, not an admission rule); the regional coefficient RK (depends on the institution's location, not the applicant's); priority admission for applicants signing a rural service agreement (service obligation); quotas for foreigners. Mandate: Law 1556-VII art. 44(3) provides quota admission for orphans, persons with conditions preventing external testing, combatants and residents of occupied territory (consolidated text; para 3 reworded 21.11.2023); MON order No 276 sets the shares; institution rules apply them. Institution: LNU 2023 rules (new edition approved by the Academic Council 10.07.2023) define quota-1 and quota-2 in the national wording (scanned PDF pp.3-4, read visually) and cite MON order 276 as amended by order 682. Lviv is not in the 40% list: quota-2 10% + quota-1 up to 10% = stated sum 20. Quota counts per offer not aggregated.
